title: Validated incident record form

adaptation.cancellation: Cancel closes the dialog without clearing the host-owned draft. Reopening restores the draft, so no confirmation is needed.
adaptation.simulation: The local adapter delays each save and rejects the first save once per application session, then succeeds on retry. It makes no network request and sends no notification.

automated: invalid submission retains draft, announces an error summary, and focuses the first invalid field
pending submission makes fields read-only and prevents duplicate submit or dialog closure
failed submission retains the draft and supports retry
keyboard, narrow layout, reflow, and accessibility checks run in the packed application harness

limitations: The local adapter represents one record at a time and does not model a backend, notification delivery, offline persistence, concurrent edits, localization, or high-volume data entry.
Automation supports runnable readiness only; it does not certify arbitrary consumer adaptations.
